versions.subject: Update powershell_windows_firewall_profile_disabled.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
  EventID: 4104
  ScriptBlockText|contains|all:
    - Set-NetFirewallProfile
    - -Profile
    - -Enabled
    - 'False'
